messages:
ashley: Heads up — CI is flaking on the event-contract checks for audit events after the KMS rollout. Golden-fixtures step is failing intermittently and blocking merges.
kevin: I saw that too. Error looks like a missing field in the validator: `AssertionError: missing required field 'actor.id'` but only for a couple of runs.
deploy-bot: CI #7421 failed on commit abc123. Tests: event-contracts (golden-fixtures) -> 1 failing. See /actions/7421.
pavan: Possible correlation: last week’s RBAC change introduced service-principal events that populate `principal` instead of `actor` for some internal flows. Validator schema expects `actor.id`.
maria: Can you paste the failing payload?
kevin: Sure, sample payload from the CI log: ```json
{"event_type":"access_key.use","timestamp":"2026-02-18T22:14:02Z","actor":null,"principal":{"type":"service","name":"build-runner"},"resource":{"id":"gpu-pool-3"}}
```
kevin: Validator runs with --strict, so null vs missing vs alternate field trips the check.
security-oncall: Any customer-facing impact? We had two support tickets referencing missing actor info in delivered audit bundles yesterday. Could be related.
ashley: That matches. I opened an internal ticket (INC-2026-78) to track customer reports. We need a quick mitigation in CI and a longer-term schema compatibility plan.
pavan: Short-term: tweak the golden-fixtures step to normalize `principal` -> `actor` if actor is null when generating the golden output for the validator. Also add a regression fixture that includes the service-principal shape.
maria: Long-term: introduce a schema versioning rule and backward-compat check. Validator should accept either `actor.id` or `principal.id` for one release window and emit a deprecation warning.
kevin: I can send a PR to the validator that: 1) emits a clear diff with field path when failing, 2) supports tolerant validation mode for CI with a flag, and 3) returns non-zero only on consistent failures.
ashley: For CI flakiness specifically, add a retry wrapper around the golden comparison (2 retries) and mark failures as flakes if they pass on retry. But we should not mask real regressions.
pavan: Also we should pin the fixture generation to a deterministic seed. The generator currently samples timestamps and non-deterministic ordering which can cause spurious diffs.
maria: Suggestion: add a lightweight staging smoke test that runs the validator against a live stream of events (sampling 200 events) emitted from staging with the KMS key rotation enabled. That will catch KMS-specific serialisation issues earlier.
security-oncall: Who will own the patch and the CI changes? We need an owner for the customer-facing incident and an owner for the validator fix.
pavan: I’ll own the golden-fixtures normalization and the seed pin. ETA end of day tomorrow.
kevin: I’ll own the validator diffs + tolerant mode PR. Will target a review today.
maria: I’ll add the staging smoke job and a note to run it before rolling KMS changes.
ashley: Great. Prioritize so we can close the customer tickets. Assigning to pavan/kevin/maria. I’ll update INC-2026-78 and notify support. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CI rerun requested by kevin (action: rerun-tests).
kevin: Rerun passed locally after a regen of the golden fixture with the normalization patch. Pushing PR now.
ashley: Thanks — let’s monitor for any more support reports and add a postmortem if we see more than 5 impacted customers.
security-oncall: Noted. I’ll keep the incident open until we confirm audit bundle integrity across affected tenants.
